# Internal Control and Regulatory Monitoring for Strategy 2026

This document addresses key actions required for internal control and regulatory compliance in alignment with the 2026 strategy.

*   We need to update the internal control quarterly.
*   We need to monitor the regulatory changes for strategy 2026.
*   We need to monitor the internal control for strategy 2026.
*   We need to optimize the regulatory changes for strategy 2026.
*   We need to review the internal control quarterly.
